organizationId.description: Organization client ID. Defaults to ZEROPS_ORGANIZATION_ID; otherwise exactly one membership is required.

postgresqlMinDiskGb.description: PostgreSQL disk floor in GB, with at most three decimal places. Defaults to ZEROPS_POSTGRESQL_MIN_DISK_GB, then 2. The platform currently fails to provision PostgreSQL below this floor (generic HTTP 500 error). Lower or raise it when Zerops fixes the catalog.

token.description: Integration token. Defaults to ZEROPS_TOKEN. No sudo escalation is performed.

provider.description:
The provider type for the zerops package. By default, resources use package-wide configuration
settings, however an explicit `Provider` instance may be created and passed during resource
construction to achieve fine-grained programmatic control over provider settings. See the
[documentation](https://www.pulumi.com/docs/reference/programming-model/#providers) for more information.

zerops:index/serviceDeploy:ServiceDeploy.description:
An immutable deployment invocation. Destroy only forgets this invocation; it never stops or rolls back the service. Import is unsupported because source inputs cannot be reconstructed. Server Git mode builds branch HEAD at build time, not a pinned commit, and requires a repository zerops.yml.

## Example Usage

<!--Start PulumiCodeChooser -->
```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as zerops from "@pulumi/zerops";

const config = new pulumi.Config();
// Existing runtime service ID.
const serviceId = config.require("serviceId");
const app = new zerops.ServiceDeploy("app", {
    serviceId: serviceId,
    sourceDir: "./app",
    setup: "app",
    build: true,
    zeropsYaml: `zerops:
  - setup: app
    build:
      base: nodejs@22
      buildCommands:
        - echo build
      deployFiles:
        - index.js
    run:
      base: nodejs@22
      ports:
        - port: 3000
          protocol: tcp
          httpSupport: true
      start: node index.js
`,
}, {
    customTimeouts: {
        create: "30m",
    },
});
```
